text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Autumn of the Junior Class. Around Agnes 
Digital, the season was steadily moving 
forward for the other Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, Trainer, over here, 
over here! The much-anticipated, 
mouth-watering race is about to start!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now for this year's Mile Championship! 
Into the final stretch, who will fly 
forth?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes King Halo on the outside! King 
Halo! King Halo crosses the finish line in 
second place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To all the King fans across the nation, 
were you watching? It's a shame I couldn't 
win, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This sprint/mile route is my new path! 
O-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooooohh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-What tremendous resolve! Ohhh... tears 
are flowing like a waterfall...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Did you understand what King-san just 
said? Shall I explain it? Yes, I will! 
This surge of passion simply cannot be 
stopped!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even reply, Agnes Digital 
began to speak.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King-san was fixated on the royal road all 
this time to prove her own talent to the 
mother she respects so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And then! In a shocking turn of events! A 
sudden shift in direction this year! She 
turned her back on her own aspiration!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Being true to myself is the absolute best 
answer I can give to Mother!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It was tough right after switching routes, 
but she overcame it all to get to this 
day! How huge those hardships were— 
Digitan's empathy is maxed out, in short, 
word count limit reached!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once she starts talking about Umamusume, 
Agnes Digital can't be stopped. Now that 
she was also in a position where she raced 
herself, her passion seemed to have 
deepened even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer, hide.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just like King used to be, there's an 
Umamusume right now in the depths of 
distress...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Look, over there...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, everyone was so wonderful. And yet, 
I...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Doto-san... has hit a plateau lately. 
Opera O-san has completely pulled ahead of 
her, too...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san was the star of the Classic 
races, too, and is widely considered a 
favorite for this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Doto-san hasn't run in 
a single GⅠ yet.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The old me would have just basked in the 
sheer preciousness of Doto-san trying her 
best, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've debuted, I kind of 
understand the pain a little bit...
choice_data_list: If only we knew the reason for the slump.
If only we knew the reason for the slump.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"That part's totally obvious, though. It 
couldn't be clearer to me."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital spoke nonchalantly, so I 
decided to ask her the reason why.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why, basically, Doto-san 
hasn't reached her "bloom" period yet, 
y'see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume-chans go through what's called a 
"growth spurt period." That's when their 
moe bodies develop into fiery, passionate 
bodies, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Doto-san is clearly a late bloomer. Right 
now, we're just waiting for her to sprout, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So there's no need to fret! Time is the 
only thing that'll fix this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...And that's my take on it, after having 
seen tons of Umamusume in my time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It'd be nice if someone noticed and said a 
word to them. That would put their mind at 
ease, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hae? Who is?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeh?! M-M-M-Me?! No way, no way, that's 
impossible~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It would be terribly presumptuous for 
someone like me to intrude! What if, 
heaven forbid, I were to have a bad 
influence on things?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fans don't give idols advice! Delusional 
fans like that usually end up getting 
banned...
choice_data_list: You're not just a fan anymore, are you?
You aren't just a fan anymore, are you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I suppose that's one way to look 
at it. But between Doto-san and me, 
there's an insurmountable wall, so~...
choice_data_list:
Why not do something for her as a fellow 
Uma Musume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh, the same Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, but... Doto-san is such an inspiring 
runner, while I'm just an ordinary one...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've started to understand the pain 
of a runner a little bit, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital went quiet for a moment, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeehhhh... Are you really telling me to do 
it...? Someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I feel like I'm being incredibly 
presumptuous...
choice_data_list: I don't think that's true, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, hearing that from a fellow comrade 
feels both encouraging and like there's no 
way out..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just one word. A single word... 
I've finally committed... the taboo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital steeled her resolve, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaah, um, Doto-san...! Could I talk to 
you for a second? I'll be done in five 
seconds!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes? What might it be, Digital-san?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you know about the Awakening? If you 
do, that's great! Do you need an 
explanation? If so, just a quick one. To 
begin with, an Umamusume is, you see...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, Agnes Digital was feeling down 
in the dumps...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I totally blew it. Seeing Doto-san 
in the flesh made me get way too 
excited...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally gave a whole 10-minute 
grand speech! And at machine-gun 
rapid-fire speed, no less!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want to get down on my knees and press 
my head to the ground in apology. How 
could I have been so rude...
choice_data_list:
Still, maybe you learned something from 
it?

Still, maybe it was good reference for 
you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't have enough self-esteem to think 
that way, you see... I'm a total 
chickenheart, yes...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Why did I overstep like this...? Even 
after her debut, I was supposed to quietly 
support her from afar, so why...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having broken her non-intervention rule 
just a tiny bit, Agnes Digital stepped in. 
What the outcome of that will be, we still 
don't know...
